# DEV apply pack, test bundle 8 (T53)

**File:** `docs/orchestrator/dev-apply-pack-b8.sql` (generated by `python3 tools/build-dev-pack-b8.py`; `node --test tests/dev-pack.test.js` fails if it is out of date).
**Where:** the Supabase SQL editor of the **DEV** project (`tuzxsqkfzrjssnpcoale`) only. Never LIVE: the pack stops by itself on a database without the organisation tables.
**Needs first:** bundle 7's pack (`dev-apply-pack.sql`). The pre-check says `ready` or lists what is MISSING.

## What it applies (one part, `db/migration_b8_fix.sql`)
It REPLACES three functions; it creates no table, column or policy and changes no row.
- `credit_consider` (F6): a trial lesson never earns a make-up credit (fixed rule, not a setting). This is the newest copy of the make-up chain (no later migration redefines it).
- `centre_deposit_run_candidates` (F4): a discarded deposit draft is raised again.
- `centre_deposit_status` (F4/F5): states `discarded`, `refunded`, `settled`; a refunded deposit is not "to collect".

## Result you should see
Pre-check: every `bundle ...` line `present`, `OVERALL ready`. After the run: three `POST-CHECK ... present` lines and `OVERALL | OK - all 3 functions carry the B8-FIX rules`. Running it twice is harmless.

## How it was tested (throwaway Postgres, never DEV)
- Chain built exactly as `tests/sql/run.sh` does up to `org_export` (= DEV after bundle 7). The pack ran in one transaction (`psql -1`): pre-check `ready`, post-check OK; a second run left an identical fingerprint (md5 of every public function's definition), and the same as applying `db/migration_b8_fix.sql` directly.
- Run on an empty database it stops with "STOP: this database has no organisation tables".
- I did **not** run anything on DEV or LIVE.

## Undo
`db/migration_b8_fix_down.sql` hands each of the three functions back exactly as it was (`tests/sql/run.sh` proves this with a fingerprint of every function).
